originating_goal: Extend VACC into governed longitudinal care-continuity analysis with record-sufficiency gating, evidence-linked provider summaries, adverse-characterization context review, prescription provenance, and disengagement/alternative-engagement signals.
claim_release_condition: Dedicated VACC repository designated; its applicable mirror handoff read or created; all requirements transferred; implementation and validation claims bound there; executable implementation and tests evidenced.
collision_boundaries: Do not create a competing VACC implementation if a canonical VACC repository or active claimant is later discovered.
Do not convert adverse labels into proof of patient fault.
Do not collapse observation, inference, potential deficiency, clinician determination, and action.
Do not infer that absence of a portal request from a narrative export proves no refill/renewal request occurred.
Do not conflate prescription expiration or refill exhaustion with clinical contraindication or ineligibility.
Do not autonomously diagnose malpractice/negligence, delete safety flags, change treatment, transfer care, or make deterministic suicide/homelessness predictions.
